versions.content: CompuMethod s of dataElement and the networkRepre- sentation are used for conversion purposes The attached CompuMethod s of both the dataElement and the networkRepresentation can be used to identify the conversion between the two. The advantage of this approach is that this can also be used without any modifications in combination with a general remapping and rescaling of dataElement s between different SwComponentType s, regardless whether they are located on the same or on different ECUs.
